title: When Do Annotator Demographics Matter? Measuring the Influence of Annotator Demographics with the POPQUORN Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Mixed-effect regression models comparing offensiveness ratings, question answering performance, and politeness ratings across annotator gender identities (Men, Women, Non-binary).
Mixed-effect regression models comparing task annotations and performance across different annotator age groups.

Mixed-effect regression models comparing task annotations across different annotator racial and ethnic groups (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White), as well as correlating aggregated subgroup ratings with original dataset scores.
Mixed-effect regression models comparing task annotations and reading comprehension performance across different levels of annotator educational attainment (High school, College, Graduate degree).
